info.title: OPS External Lead API
info.description: Server-to-server lead intake, file handoff, privacy-safe lead sync, and versioned analytics.

get.description: Returns the sources, forms, and upload limits available to this intake credential. Requires intake.write.

post.description: Creates an idempotent upload batch. Keep the OPS credential on your server; send only the returned single-use upload capability to the browser. Requires intake.write.

200.description: A new or replayed upload batch.

201.description: A new or replayed upload batch.

post.description: Creates or safely replays the original website submission and its lead/customer records. Later email belongs to the OPS email engine. Requires intake.write.

200.description: A new or replayed lead submission.

201.description: A new or replayed lead submission.

get.description: Returns safe file-processing state for the original submission. Requires intake.write.
Returns all company lead projections without customer contact details. Commit a terminal full-sync checkpoint before requesting incremental changes. Requires analytics.leads.read.

parameters.name: sync_checkpoint
parameters.description: Committed checkpoint required for incremental sync.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: Repeat to include more than one lead stage.

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: Repeat to include more than one terminal disposition.

parameters.name: record_state
parameters.description: Repeat to include more than one record state.

200.description: A full or incremental page of lead projections.

get.description: Returns metrics with explicit population, denominator, evidence coverage, suppression, timezone, and definition version. Financial metrics additionally require analytics.financial.read.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Repeat for up to one time and one source dimension.

200.description: Versioned metric cells and evidence coverage.

results.population: Leads first received during the selected range.

bearerAuth.description: Load this credential from a server-side secret. Never place it in browser code, source control, logs, URLs, or analytics.
